blocks.title: Nucleic acids
blocks.text: Nucleic acids bare biomolecules hain jo genetic (virasati) maloomat jama karte aur aage muntaqil (transmit) karte hain. Yeh polymers hain jo nucleotides naam ki chhoti units se bante hain.

Nucleic acids nucleotide zanjeeron se bante hain jin mein sugar aur phosphate groups baari baari (alternating) aate hain, aur har sugar se aik organic (nitrogen wala) base jura hota hai. RNA mein sugar ribose hai aur DNA mein deoxyribose; dono ka ring paanch kone wala (five-membered) hai. Nucleotides sugar ke 5' aur 3' carbon atoms ke zariye phosphodiester linkage se jur kar nucleic acid banate hain (Figure 27.13). Yeh amal kai million baar dohraya jata hai aur polynucleotide banta hai. Phosphodiester linkages mazboot covalent bonds hain, jo polynucleotide zanjeer ko mazbooti aur stability dete hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: do nucleotides. 5' sire par phosphate aik paanch rukni shakar ring ke 5' CH2 se jura hai jis par BASE hai; shakar ka 3' carbon O ke zariye doosre phosphate, phosphodiester linkage, se jura hai jo agli shakar aur base ke 5' CH2 se judta hai; woh shakar 3' OH par khatam hoti hai, zanjeer ka 3' sira. Daen: zanjeer bari bari phosphate aur shakar, har shakar par base.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.13: Nucleic acids (DNA aur RNA) mein nucleotide zanjeeron ki aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 27.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; jorne wala phosphate durust kiya gaya).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 5' aur 3' carbon ke number sugar ke hain. Aik nucleotide ke 3' carbon ki oxygen phosphate ke zariye agle nucleotide ke 5' CH₂ se jurti hai; yeh phosphodiester linkage hai. Kitab ne jorne wale phosphate mein 3' carbon se aane wali oxygen ko P se double bond (P=O) se dikhaya; asal mein yeh oxygen P se single bond se jurti hai aur double bond aik alag (bahar wali) oxygen par hota hai. Khaake mein sahi shakal dikhayi gayi hai.

blocks.prompt: Nucleotide kin teen hisson se banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Phosphate group, paanch carbon wali sugar (ribose ya deoxyribose) aur nitrogen wala base.

items: Nucleic acids: nucleotides (phosphate + sugar + base) ke polymers; genetic maloomat jama aur muntaqil karte hain.
RNA mein ribose, DNA mein deoxyribose.
Sugar-phosphate reerh phosphodiester links (5' se 3') se juri hai.
